chars.S: SON: a 19-year-old young man wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie with a black stripe across the chest, black joggers and white sneakers.
chars.F: FATHER: a stern man in his fifties wearing a grey knitted cardigan over a white shirt, brown trousers, thin rectangular glasses and a short grey moustache.
chars.M: MOTHER: a warm woman in her late forties wearing a long burgundy house djellaba and a soft beige headscarf.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a modest Moroccan apartment in Casablanca living room with low banquette sofas and patterned zellige cushions. The FATHER stands frowning, holding up a school results sheet at arm's length and staring at it in disbelief, face clearly visible; the SON stands beside him with his head down, hands in his hoodie pocket.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Inside a modest Moroccan apartment in Casablanca living room. The FATHER points a finger and lectures the SON with an annoyed face; the SON stands still, shoulders slumped, looking at the floor.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Inside a modest Moroccan apartment in Casablanca small bedroom with a desk. The SON sits at the desk holding a results sheet, his other hand on his forehead, shocked and defeated.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: On the flat rooftop terrace of a Casablanca building at dusk, satellite dishes and laundry lines behind. The SON sits alone on a plastic chair wearing headphones, writing in a notebook, looking misunderstood and thoughtful.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Inside a modest Moroccan apartment in Casablanca at a low round dinner table with a tajine. The FATHER and MOTHER eat and glance coldly at the SON, who sits across from them silent and uncomfortable.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Inside a modest Moroccan apartment in Casablanca living room, warm happy light. The FATHER smiles proudly and pats the SON on the shoulder while the SON holds up a good school report and grins.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Inside a modest Moroccan apartment in Casablanca hallway. The FATHER turns away with a sour irritated face, waving his hand dismissively; the SON stands behind him looking hurt.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Inside a modest Moroccan apartment in Casablanca living room. The FATHER sits on the banquette reading a newspaper, ignoring the SON, who stands next to him trying to talk with an open hand and a hopeful face.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Inside a modest Moroccan apartment in Casablanca kitchen with blue zellige tiles and a teapot on the stove. The MOTHER gently puts her hand on the SON's shoulder and smiles tenderly at him; the SON looks at her, comforted.
